messages:
Rae (People Ops): Quick sync 1: launching a small Microgrant recognition pilot for Q3. $300 grants up to 20 recipients/month. Goal: spotlight discretionary acts that align to our values. Nom window: 48 hours. Managers approve. Need workflow and GL.

Omar (Finance): GL: 4-130-MGR. We'll need a monthly cap check and CSV: employee_id, name, amount, reason, nominator, manager_approved_ts. Approvals in by the 25th for next-month payout.

Nina (Talent Partner): Can nominations be anonymous? Some folks prefer it.

Rae (People Ops): Yes optional anonymity. Form will allow anonymous nominator; managers will still get notified but we won't show nominator in comms. Edge-case: anonymous + manager nominated = show manager name.

Samir (Eng): Who sits on approval? Some teams worry about bias.

Rae (People Ops): Managers do first-pass approval for directs; People Ops does a light review for fairness (look for repeated recipients) and Finance does payout. For disputed cases we escalate to Talent. We'll publish brief calibration notes.

spot-awards-bot: Nom form: https://forms.gle/microgrant-q3 (goes live 2026-07-01 09:00 PT). Reminder schedule set.

Omar (Finance): Also need to know tax handling per region. We'll flag any recipient totals >600 for payroll. Send me the export format.

Rae (People Ops): Export fields: employee_id,name,email,amount,reason,nominator,anonymous_flag,manager,manager_approved_ts,gl_code. I'll draft the comms and a one-slide FAQ.

Nina (Talent Partner): I'll help draft calibration bullets and a quick bias checklist for managers.

Samir (Eng): Sounds great. Can we run a monthly highlight post? Small blurb + photo (opt-in).

Rae (People Ops): Yes opt-in for public recognition. We'll include an opt-in checkbox on the form. Launch plan: pilot July-September, review metrics: #unique nominators, repeat winners, spend vs budget, and manager feedback. Thanks all.
